description: One continuous natural sacred garden planting mass, irregular crescent-shaped patch of connected low dark moss-green shrubs and ground-cover foliage interwoven with tiny cream and muted crimson flowers, three irregular moss-covered basalt rocks partly buried among plants. Wide horizontal low silhouette, varying height under knee high, lush organically connected vegetation with sparse ragged edges. Original Thai shaman MMORPG pixel art, elevated three-quarter overhead camera with visible rock front faces, detailed crisp pixels, earthy jade green and moss, muted antique palette. Transparent background. NO trees, NO pots, NO planters, NO walls, NO rectangular ground tile, NO pedestal, NO straight border, NO isolated separate objects. Plants and moss physically join the rocks in one coherent organic cluster.
